name: King of the Party
review:
King of the Party is a 6-reel jungle-club slot with a lion DJ, scatter pays, multipliers and overlay multiplier symbols.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 5,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.32%.

Scatter pays mean symbols can win from anywhere on the grid, and overlay multipliers add extra value to the positions they cover. The lion DJ and jungle club theme keep it light.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
